entities.summary: "Eyes Open" is a song written and recorded by the American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift for the soundtrack to the 2012 film The Hunger Games. Produced by Swift and Nathan Chapman, it is an alternative rock power ballad instrumented with chiming guitars, evoking pop-punk and space rock sounds. The lyrics are about resilience during hardships, told from the perspective of the film's protagonist, Katniss Everdeen. The song was released as a single from the soundtrack on March 27, 2012.
